files_changed.summary: Postman Collection v2.1 JSON for direct Supabase Auth requests plus current gateway /healthz and authenticated /v1/me routes.
Task record for the Postman API collection artifact.
Analysis record listing backend and agent-history sources read before generating the collection.
Added task 004 to the task sequence and moved the process pointer into the task while active.

decisions: Used Postman Collection v2.1 format because it is directly importable in Postman.
Included Supabase Auth signup/signin/refresh/get-user/logout requests because the backend login proxy task was cancelled and auth issuance is owned by Supabase.
Included only the gateway routes currently wired in router.go: GET /healthz and GET /v1/me.
Used collection variables for Supabase URL, anon key, email, password, access token, and refresh token; no real secret values were stored.
